description: This file contains unit tests for the AuthorizationCodeRepository class within the OAuth module of the OrangeHRM project. It verifies creation, persistence, revocation, and status-checking of authorization codes, utilizing PHPUnit testing framework.

classes.name: AuthorizationCodeRepositoryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the functionality of AuthorizationCodeRepository, including creation, persistence, revocation, and status checks of OAuth authorization codes within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data environment before each test, loading predefined authorization code fixtures.

methods.name: testGetNewAuthCode
methods.description: Verifies that a new AuthCodeEntity can be created and its properties are initialized as expected.

methods.name: testPersistNewAuthCode
methods.description: Tests persisting a new authorization code and verifies it correctly saved to the database with proper properties.

methods.name: testPersistNewAuthCodeWithExistingAuthCode
methods.description: Checks that attempting to persist a duplicate authorization code triggers a UniqueTokenIdentifierConstraintViolationException.

methods.name: testRevokeAuthCode
methods.description: Ensures that revoking an authorization code updates its status to revoked in the database.

methods.name: testRevokeNonExistingAuthCode
methods.description: Verifies that revoking a non-existent authorization code does not cause errors and silently continues.

methods.name: testIsAuthCodeRevoked
methods.description: Checks the revoked status of known authorization codes, expecting false for active and true for revoked codes.

methods.name: testIsAuthCodeRevokedForNonExistingAuthCode
methods.description: Confirms that checking revoke status for a non-existent code returns true (interpreted as revoked).
